decision: Resume existing spec 062 as compatible drift
evidence: 062 already owns per-table completeness and the deployed bug is an uncovered merged-origin shape
consequence: Amend spec/plan/tasks instead of creating a competing specification

decision: Split one physical origin row into parent and first-leaf facts only under five explicit conditions
evidence: Live 1377 artifact has rowspan origin title total plus non-empty detail and explicit maximum, followed by a scored continuation
consequence: Preserve ordinary and ambiguous merged rows while restoring all leaf weights

evidence: The guards correctly exposed 95/86 instead of 100
consequence: Fix semantic projection at the extractor source and retain fail-closed behavior

decision: Require a scored continuation before splitting a merged origin
evidence: Existing regression has a formatting-only blank continuation; rowspan alone does not prove a parent-child group
consequence: Avoid inventing redundant parents while preserving the 1377 multi-child shape

decision: Index parent linkage only from the mapped dimension column
evidence: Two independent reviewers reproduced multi-column vMerge overwriting the row-only origin map
consequence: Keep continuation leaves attached to the semantic dimension parent when code and dimension columns both merge

decision: Use DOTALL (?s) flag for CATEGORY_TITLE_PATTERN in DeterministicScoreFactExtractor
evidence: Production cell raw text is '部分\n（30\n分）' with newline and rowspan=1; standard regex '.*' fails on newline causing fallback to extract 30 as leaf weight inflating total to 130
consequence: Accurately identifies category title across newlines and prevents continuation row title weight fallback hijacking category score

decision: Retain title weight fallback for genuine leaf items while blocking parent categories
evidence: Disabling title weight fallback globally broke Project 1381 where score is embedded in leaf dimension titles
consequence: Protects against fix-A-break-B regressions across different table layout archetypes

decision: Deploy release 6fad0758b to production and verify live pipeline execution
evidence: Project 33 parsing failed in prod with WEIGHT_SUM_MISMATCH (130 pts) prior to DOTALL fix; re-extracting with new release produced AUTO_APPROVED with exact 100.0 pts and 13 items
consequence: Confirmed live fix on production host 172.16.10.149 with all 13 score items persisted to DB

evidence: Sidecar read timeout (ResourceAccessException) repeated 3 times caused 180s+ hanging and 499 disconnects; noRetryFor ensures immediate fallback to local extractor
consequence: Eliminates 3x timeout amplification, fails fast into local docx extraction

decision: Configure AuthenticationEntryPoint for 401 response on unauthenticated requests
evidence: Spring Security 6 default Http403ForbiddenEntryPoint returns 403 on missing auth, causing frontend client.js to trap user without refreshing token or redirecting to /login
consequence: Aligns with HTTP 401 semantics and allows frontend interceptor to handle session expiration cleanly

decision: Disable ScoreParseDrawer reparse buttons when scoringOverlayVisible or loading
evidence: User repeatedly clicked re-parse during long document parsing triggering multiple parallel jobs and resource contention
consequence: Prevents duplicate concurrent parse requests from frontend UI

decision: Add AiProviderDiagnostics to ScoreParseTask run_summary with strict credential sanitization and preserved key order
evidence: Lack of structured telemetry for model name, latency, and error details in parse results prevented reliable failure attribution; sanitization prevents secret leaks
consequence: Enabled downstream observability and post-mortem debugging while preserving 100% backward compatibility for GoldenCasesReplayTest and existing consumers

decision: Force json_object format with gateway 400 fallback in OpenAiCompatibleClient
consequence: Ensures native structured JSON output from Gemini/DeepSeek/Kimi while gracefully falling back for non-compliant gateways

decision: Relax ANALYSIS_MAX_TOKENS from hardcoded 2000 to 4096 in OpenAiCompatibleClient
consequence: Prevents mid-generation truncation on comprehensive tender evaluation outputs, fulfilling lessons-learned #201

decision: Increase HTTP client read timeout from 30s to 60s in OpenAiCompatibleClient
consequence: Eliminates transient read timeout 500 errors on complex long prompts and latency spikes

decision: Assert mergeable=true and verify origin/main baseline sync for PR 2743
consequence: Confirmed PR is conflict-free against origin/main 959d2243e and ready for squash merge

decision: Targeted 3-part algorithm fixes for Project 1382 scoreparse (Sidecar table bbox filtering, ChildAggregation additive/shared-cap decoupling, and PdfRowEvidenceBinder cross-column row cell pairing)
evidence: Tender 《办公用品.pdf》 failed on B3 sharedCap misclassification, table-interior section breaks truncating outline, and non-adjacent quote binding rejection; all verified with pytest (61 passed), backend unit tests (25 passed), 35 golden cases replay, and ArchUnit
consequence: Enables full 100-point scoreparse extraction for Project 1382 under APP_SCORE_PARSE_EXTRACTION_VERSION_ENABLED=false without regressions or schema changes
